hints.title: Mirror Character Mapping
hints.text: A character c has mirror counterpart mapping to 'z' minus (ord(c) - ord('a')).

hints.title: Closest Unmarked Match
hints.text: To pair with the closest unmarked predecessor, query the most recently recorded index for the mirror character.

hints.title: Per-Character LIFO Storage
hints.text: Maintain separate index stacks for each of the 26 letters, popping top matches and accumulating index differences.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Each character index is pushed and popped at most once across alphabet stacks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning backwards to find the nearest unmarked mirror causes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) space stores index history in alphabet stacks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses 26 stacks to achieve linear amortized nearest mirror matching.
